verdict.line: You lose if you get vesseled by Test of Spirit or forced into isolated trades before level 6; you win by stacking Fury for empowered combos and using Executioner's Calling to shut off her tentacle sustain mid-game.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's E (Test of Spirit) is the whole matchup: land it on you and if you can't kill the spirit or get out of range, you become a Vessel that spawns Tentacles against yourself, and every Tentacle hit heals her off her passive. Renekton has no way to interrupt that ability, so lane is about minimizing exposure to it and only committing once Fury is above 50, which is when Q, W, and E all get meaningfully stronger.

theirWindow.when: After Test of Spirit lands on you
theirWindow.what: Immediately decide: burst the spirit down with Q and autos before it expires, or disengage to max range so you don't get too far and flip into a Vessel. Standing still and trading normally while the spirit is up is how you lose the exchange.

yourWindow.when: Once you cross 50 Fury near level 6
yourWindow.what: Engage with the empowered W (Ruthless Predator) for the three-hit, 1.5s stun and shield-destroy, chain into empowered E (Slice and Dice) for bonus damage and Armor reduction, and use R (Dominus) for the bonus Health and Fury generation to outlast her Tentacle healing during the fight.

start.why: The dominant start at 43.9% win rate over 1099 games; the lifesteal keeps you healthy while auto-attacking to build Fury, which is the resource your whole kit runs on in this matchup.

boots.why: Run on 84.2% of games at 45.6% win rate; Illaoi's Harsh Lesson, Tentacle swings, and passive damage are all physical auto-attack-style hits that Steelcaps flatly reduces.

core.why: First item on the top-performing path (52.6% over 137 games); the shield and burst proc line up with your empowered W into E all-in once Fury is up.
Stacks Armor shred on top of your empowered E's own Armor reduction, letting your combo punch through Illaoi's tank-adjacent stats.
Highest win rate finisher on the top path; the damage-over-time conversion and healing help you survive the extended trades her Tentacle passive is built to win.

you need more survivability against her all-in and tentacle burst
you're already ahead and want faster uptime on your empowered abilities

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks off repeated Q swings and auto-attacks while you're building Fury, then converts into extra damage and healing right when you commit your empowered W-E all-in, helping you keep pace with her Tentacle sustain over a longer fight.

summoners.why: Run in 86.6% of games at 45.3% win rate; Ignite directly answers Illaoi's passive Tentacle self-heal and helps you close out kills before she sustains back through the trade.

playing.title: React to Test of Spirit instantly
playing.detail: The moment she lands it, either burst the spirit down with Q before it expires or fully disengage so you don't drift too far and become a Vessel spawning Tentacles on yourself.

playing.title: Bank Fury before committing
playing.detail: Auto-attack and Q to build Fury, and hold your all-in until you're above 50, since a sub-50 W is only a two-hit, 0.75s stun that's too weak to punish through her sustain.

playing.title: Respect Harsh Lesson at levels 1-2
playing.detail: Her 4-second cooldown leap lets her poke you repeatedly before you have a stun of your own; hold max melee range between minion waves rather than trading blade-to-blade.

playing.title: Open all-ins with empowered E
playing.detail: At 50+ Fury, Slice and Dice deals bonus damage and reduces the Armor of units hit, so dash in with it first to make your follow-up empowered W hit harder.

playing.title: Time Executioner's Calling to her healing
playing.detail: Once her passive Tentacles start regularly healing her back up in trades, prioritize Executioner's Calling immediately rather than waiting for your full build.

playing.title: Use Dominus as a trade tool, not just a finisher
playing.detail: Both ultimates unlock at level 6; pop Dominus for the bonus Health and passive Fury generation before an extended trade so you can out-sustain her Leap of Faith tentacle spawns.

playing.title: Avoid isolated all-ins before 6
playing.detail: She has the solo-kill advantage in this matchup; play for wave state and Q healing rather than forcing 1-for-1 fights until your Eclipse and Fury threshold are online.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, summoner, and win-rate numbers are measured from live games on the current patch (16.18.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own read on how those numbers play out in lane.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being hit with Illaoi’s (E) while laning. Purchase Executioner’s Calling, and try engaging aggressively after building up Fury.
